purpose: Provide a content-addressed proof method for existing canonical ingest assertions so a consumer does not need to re-download every verbose chunk merely to re-prove row counts and exact-file identity already verified by the producer.
design_basis: OCI-style descriptors bind referenced content to digest and byte size.
TUF-style target metadata records hashes and lengths so clients can validate exact target objects from compact metadata.
Git repository metadata exposes immutable blob SHA and size for files without downloading file contents.

must_verify: source chunk count equals source index
source row count equals source item_count
every source row has the indexed column count
mailing projection preserves one row per source row
mailing chunk count equals generated descriptor count
mailing row count equals source item_count

allowed_only_if_all: mailing index contains integrity_attestation with proof_method content_addressed_producer_attestation
current Git blob SHA and size of source manifest exactly match attested descriptor
current Git blob SHA and size of source index exactly match attested descriptor
the exact current source chunk path set equals the attested source chunk path set
every current source chunk Git blob SHA and size exactly match its attested descriptor
the exact current mailing chunk path set equals the attested mailing chunk path set
every current mailing chunk Git blob SHA and size exactly match its attested descriptor
attested source chunk count equals canonical source index count copied into mailing index
attested mailing chunk count equals mailing index chunk_count
canonical manifest/index QA values copied into mailing index satisfy canonical thresholds
consumer_fast_path.proof_semantics: When all exact blob identities match, the producer's direct validation applies to the same immutable bytes currently in the repository. The consumer is verifying identity of already-read exact content, not assuming similarity from filenames or counts.
consumer_fast_path.if_any_check_fails: FAST_PATH_INVALID; fall back to direct canonical ingest if feasible, otherwise fail closed.

diagnostic_stage_03.pass_requires: all canonical ingest QA assertions proven either by direct read or by the exact content-addressed producer attestation fast path
